label: Zeffy
description: Start workflows from new payments and donor contacts; manage contacts, offline payments and campaigns

operations.name: list_payments
operations.description: List payments, with optional donor, campaign, status and date filters.

operations.name: get_payment
operations.description: Read a single payment belonging to the organization.

operations.name: create_payment
operations.description: Record an offline payment, without charging a card. Auctions are unsupported.

operations.name: delete_payment
operations.description: Permanently delete a manual/imported payment; cancel its receipt and keep its contact. No email is sent. Online payments cannot be deleted.

operations.name: list_contacts
operations.description: Find contacts by exact primary or secondary email, or by creation/update time.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Read a single contact belonging to the organization.

operations.name: create_contact
operations.description: Create a contact with email or both names. Existing emails return a conflict.

operations.name: upsert_contact
operations.description: Create or update by email (primary or secondary); the match email is not rewritten.

operations.name: update_contact
operations.description: Update supplied fields on a contact. Explicit null clears a field.

operations.name: delete_contact
operations.description: Permanently delete a contact, with the dashboard's side effects. Active memberships prevent deletion.

operations.name: list_campaigns
operations.description: List the organization's donation forms and ticketing campaigns.

operations.name: get_campaign
operations.description: Read a single campaign belonging to the organization.

operations.name: list_users
operations.description: List organization team members, including removed users when requested.

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Read a single user belonging to the organization.

operations.name: on_new_payment
operations.description: Start when a new payment is recorded, regardless of status.

operations.name: on_new_contact
operations.description: Start when a new donor contact is created.

operations.name: on_new_or_updated_contact
operations.description: Start when a donor contact is created or its updated timestamp changes.
